If $\omega_0, \omega_1, \omega_2 \ldots \omega_{n-1}$ are nth root of unity, then

x^n-1=\left(x-\omega_0\right)\left(x-\omega_1\right)\left(x-\omega_2\right) \ldots\left(x-\omega_{n-1}\right)

put $x=\frac{-1}{2}$, we get

\begin{aligned}
& \left(\frac{-1}{2}\right)^n-1=\left(\frac{-1}{2}-\omega_0\right)\left(\frac{-1}{2}-\omega_1\right) \ldots\left(-\frac{1}{2}-\omega_{n-1}\right) \\
& \Rightarrow\left(-\frac{1}{2}\right)^n-1=\left(-\frac{1}{2}\right)^n\left(1-2 \omega_0\right) \\
& \quad\left(1+2 \omega_1\right) \ldots\left(1-2 \omega_{n-1}\right) \\
& \Rightarrow 1-(-1)^n(2)^n=\left(1+2 \omega_0\right)\left(1+2 \omega_1\right) \ldots\left(1+2 \omega_{n-1}\right) \\
& \Rightarrow 1+(-1)^{n-1} 2^n=\left(1+2 \omega_0\right)\left(1+2 \omega_1\right) \ldots\left(1+2 \omega_{n-1}\right)
\end{aligned}
